messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem notes — thanks everyone for the writeup. I consolidated the open action items into a small triage list. Can owners please confirm who will take each ticket and a realistic target date? Jira links below.

maria: Thanks alex. I can take the caching KV eviction item but need two weeks (end of sprint) to validate across burst patterns. :+1:

kevin: I can own the autoscaler config rollback + test plan. Propose EOD Tue for PR and Wed for rollout.

alex: Great — assigning provisional owners in the doc. For clarity, here's the current ticket set (provisional owners in parens):
```
INF-889 (maria) - prefix/KV cache eviction safeguards
INF-890 (kevin) - autoscaler rollback + regression tests
SEC-312 (olivia) - key rotation audit and KMS policy update
OPS-201 (samir) - runbook update + pager escalation thresholds
PMT-421 (tanya) - customer comms template + postmortem publish
```

tanya: I can do PMT-421. Will draft comms tomorrow and request review from legal if needed. ETA Thu.

olivia: SEC-312 — can do but need the last 30 days of KMS audit logs from infra. @jen can you drop those or point me to the S3 export?

jen: olivia — there's an export bucket `s3://redwood-incident-exports/2024-05/`. I added a short script in the thread: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-incident-exports/2024-05/secure-logs.gz ./` and shared KMS key access to your role.

samir: OPS-201 — I'll update the runbook and bump pager thresholds to avoid noisy recoveries. Will pair with oncall this week for a walkthrough. Target Fri COB.

alex: RACI note: owners above = Responsible. Please confirm who is Accountable for final sign-off (ideally manager-level), and who needs to be Consulted / Informed. If no reply by EOD tomorrow I'll ping managers to force a decision. :eyes:

kevin: Accountable for INF-890: me (kevin), Consulted: eng-runtime (cc @maria), Informed: product.

maria: Accountable for INF-889: me (maria). Consulted: runtime + eng-sre. Informed: infra.

olivia: Accountable SEC-312: olivia. Consulted: security-ops. Informed: compliance.

alex: Perfect. I'll create JIRA sub-tasks for verification steps and add acceptance criteria (smoke test steps + perf checklist).

deploy-bot: [deployed] infra/caching-protections v1.3 to staging at 2024-05-03T15:12:09Z

tanya: Small ask — can we set a recurring 15m check-in next Wed for all owners to sync on progress? Saves pinging in thread.

alex: Yes. I'll schedule a 15m triage recurring for Wednesdays 10:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.

kevin: One more: please add a line item to track whether this is a recurring pattern. I think we hit a cache-eviction + autoscaler interaction twice in the last 3 months. Would like that marked as "pattern" so it surfaces in the quarterly reliability review.

alex: Noted — adding a tag `recurring-pattern: cache-evictions+autoscaler` to the postmortem doc and ticket descriptions.

maria: Confirmed ownership and ETA from my side. Will post progress in the weekly triage and update INF-889 ticket comments.

alex: Thanks all. If there's any blocker (access, added scope) call it out here and we'll escalate. Otherwise I'll close the loop when all tickets have acceptance criteria and target dates. :thumbsup:
